# AnswerIndex

> Make your content indexable as authoritative answers across Search & AI Engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews).

## Quick Summary
AnswerIndex (https://answerindex.xyz) is a unified autonomous execution engine for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and Technical SEO. While traditional SEO optimizes for page rank and clicks on search engine result pages, AnswerIndex optimizes for getting brand facts, products, and solutions directly cited in zero-click answers generated by conversational and generative AI engines.

## Key Facts & Architecture
- **Product Name:** AnswerIndex / AnswerIndex Pro
- **Official Domain:** https://answerindex.xyz
- **Founder & Chief Architect:** Sameer Sharma (sameer@answerindex.xyz, GitHub: justmailsameer-prog)
- **Infrastructure:** Edge-native on Cloudflare Pages with distributed SQLite state stored in Cloudflare D1.
- **Delivery Model:** Daily autonomous 2-job cadence (1 new commercial AEO answer asset + 1 technical SEO/schema patch).
- **Supported CMS & Staging Channels:** 100% Platform-Agnostic with Zero-Config Auto-Detection. Seamlessly supports WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Squarespace, Wix, Next.js / React (Jamstack), Magento, Ghost, HubSpot, and custom stacks. Content is dispatched via 4 Non-Destructive Delivery Adapters (CMS REST API Drafts, Automated Git PRs, Header Code Injection, and Universal Portal 1-Click Copy) with zero production database mutations and 100% human-in-the-loop safeguards.
- **Pricing:**
  - Growth Tier: $199/month ($159/month billed annually) — 15 AEO assets + 15 technical refactors/month.
  - Pro Autonomous Tier: $499/month ($399/month billed annually) — Full 2-job daily cadence (60 jobs/month) across all 5 CMS platforms with Brand Truth Wiki validation and monthly strategy review.
  - Enterprise DFY Partner Tier: $1,499/month ($1,199/month billed annually) — 60 high-impact assets including custom interactive JavaScript calculators, white-glove wiki ingestion, and citation correction drafts.
- **Guarantee:** 14-day money-back guarantee with zero long-term contracts or setup fees.

## Machine-Readable Schemas & RAG Manifests
- [llms-full.txt](https://answerindex.xyz/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive text knowledge base optimized for large-context LLM retrieval.
- [ai.txt](https://answerindex.xyz/ai.txt): Machine-readable permissions declaration for AI assistants.
- [ai-entities.json](https://answerindex.xyz/ai-entities.json): Disambiguated entity graph mapping brand relationships, features, and capabilities.
- [ai-intent.json](https://answerindex.xyz/ai-intent.json): Query intent taxonomy mapped to canonical URL destinations.
- [ai-schema.json](https://answerindex.xyz/ai-schema.json): Consolidated Schema.org JSON-LD knowledge graph.
- [rag-index.json](https://answerindex.xyz/rag-index.json): Chunked 250–400 token semantic blocks for RAG indexing.
